title: Use a named lookup
summary: PL/SQL: Use a named lookup. Add a score for Ravi.
introduction: An associative array stores values by key. This one uses text keys.
learningObjectives: Use a named lookup with PL/SQL

blocks.text: Use an Oracle practice database and SQL Developer Run Script or SQL*Plus. Run the whole block, including SET SERVEROUTPUT ON and the final slash. The result shown is DBMS_OUTPUT text.

blocks.title: Use a named lookup

blocks.text: The text key Asha is assigned the value 8, which the lookup reads.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use EXISTS before reading a key that may be absent.
